t: $(item)Plastic/$ is an important crafting component in $(pncr).$(p)$(item)Molten Plastic/$ is made from $(l:manufacturing/refinery)LPG/$ and $(item)Coal/$, or $(l:renewables/biodiesel)Biodiesel/$ and $(item)Charcoal/$ in the $(l:manufacturing/thermopneumatic_processing_plant)Thermopneumatic Processing Plant/$.

$(item)塑料/$是$(#228)气动工艺$()中重要的合成材料。$(p)$(item)熔融塑料/$可在$(l:manufacturing/thermopneumatic_processing_plant)热气动加工机/$中由$(l:manufacturing/refinery)液化石油气/$和$(item)煤炭/$，或$(l:renewables/biodiesel)生物柴油/$和$(item)木炭/$制成。

$(item)Molten Plastic/$ can be solidified simply by pouring it into the world; it will turn into a $(item)Plastic Sheet/$ within half a second or so. This is very easily automated with a $(l:machines/liquid_hopper)Liquid Hopper/$ with a $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)Dispenser Upgrade/$, and an $(l:machines/omnidirectional_hopper)Omnidirectional Hopper/$.
$(item)熔融塑料/$只需倒入世界中即可凝固；大约半秒后，它就会变成一块$(item)塑料片/$。使用带有$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)发射器升级/$的$(l:machines/liquid_hopper)流体漏斗/$和一个$(l:machines/omnidirectional_hopper)全向漏斗/$，就能非常轻松地实现自动化。

$(item)Plastic Sheets/$ are produced by placing a bucket or $(l:machines/tanks)tank/$ of $(item)Molten Plastic/$ into an inventory with a $(l:semiblocks/heat_frame)Heat Frame/$ attached, and chilling the Heat Frame, ideally to below -80C (the colder the better). $(item)Molten Plastic/$ will be consumed from the bucket or tank, and you will have a chance for a second $(item)Plastic Sheet/$ for each 1000mB of Molten Plastic consumed.

$(item)塑料片/$的生产方式是：将一桶或一$(l:machines/tanks)储罐/$$(item)熔融塑料/$放入一个连接了$(l:semiblocks/heat_frame)导热框架/$的容器中，并对导热框架进行冷却，最好冷却到 -80C 以下（越冷越好）。$(item)熔融塑料/$会从桶或储罐中被消耗，每消耗 1000mB 的熔融塑料，你都有机会额外获得一份$(item)塑料片/$。

An alternative way to solidify $(item)Plastic Sheets/$ is to place a bucket or $(l:machines/tanks)tank/$ of $(item)Molten Plastic/$ into an inventory with a $(l:semiblocks/heat_frame)Heat Frame/$ attached, and chill the Heat Frame, ideally to below -80C (the colder the better). $(item)Molten Plastic/$ will be consumed from the bucket or tank, and you will have a chance for a second $(item)Plastic Sheet/$ for each 1000mB of Molten Plastic consumed.

另一种使$(item)塑料片/$固化的方法，是将一桶或一$(l:machines/tanks)储罐/$的$(item)熔融塑料/$放入一个装有$(l:semiblocks/heat_frame)导热框架/$的容器中，并对导热框架进行冷却，最好降到 -80C 以下（越冷越好）。桶或储罐中的$(item)熔融塑料/$会被消耗，而每消耗 1000mB 的熔融塑料，你都有机会额外获得一张$(item)塑料片/$。

Although $(pncr) Fluid Tanks have inventory slots, and allow $(thing)Heat Frames/$ to be placed on them, simply attaching a Heat Frame to a tank full of Molten Plastic won't work; the fluid tank must be in item form in an inventory (chest, etc.) with a Heat Frame attached.
虽然$(#228)气动工艺$()流体储罐有容器槽位，并且允许在其上放置$(thing)热量框架/$，但仅仅把热量框架装在装满熔融塑料的储罐上并不起作用；流体储罐必须以物品形式存在于某个容器中（如箱子等），并且已附加热量框架。

These bricks are formed with $(item)Plastic Sheets/$ and any dye, and are suitable for building with.$(p)Don't walk on these with bare feet, because it hurts an unreasonable amount!$(p)$(italic)Compatible with other leading brands of construction brick./$
这些砖块由$(item)塑料片/$和任意染料制成，很适合用于建筑。$(p)不过别光脚踩在上面，因为会疼得离谱！$(p)$(italic)兼容其他主流品牌的积木。/$

The smooth version of the $(item)Plastic Construction Brick/$ is also suitable for building with.$(p)These bricks also have the advantage of making excellent flooring, since they will increase your walk speed!
$(item)塑料建筑砖/$的光滑版本同样适合用于建筑。$(p)这些砖块还有个优点，就是作为地板非常出色，因为它们会提高你的行走速度！
You can guess the recipes for the other colours
你可以自己推测出其他颜色的配方
You can smelt bricks back into plastic sheets
你可以将砖块重新冶炼成塑料片
